milestone: Bounded native BPE/ByteLevel vocabulary loading and per-token decoding
status: qualified component; full goal remains active

json.limits: Explicit max_bytes/max_nodes per document. Default init remains16MiB/65536nodes; depth remains64. Input extents above PTRDIFF_MAX rejected. Array growth uses selected node cap with overflow checks.
json.member_order: Sorted decoded-key order, borrowed immutable key/value; invalid access preserves key output.
json.budget_scope: Serialized input/value node caps; allocator overhead and exact owned heap bytes are not represented by these two caps.

vocabulary.profile: ID-indexed BPE vocabulary with ByteLevel decoder. Core and added IDs must fill the expected range; identical core/added overlap allowed, conflicting or repeated added IDs rejected.
vocabulary.ownership: One budgeted metadata allocation; immutable strings borrowed from the JSON document. The document must remain initialized and unchanged throughout use. Destructor frees only owned metadata.
vocabulary.decode_semantics: Per-token decode([id],skip_special_tokens=false), matching Rust ByteLevel and UTF-8 lossy error-prefix replacement. Unmapped Unicode scalars retain original UTF-8. Output is length-counted and may contain NUL; no terminator is appended. contains_replacement includes literal U+FFFD, matching Engram raw-token fallback.
vocabulary.failure: Invalid ID/capacity preserves output. Direct overlaps with current raw piece, metadata/handle or written are rejected. Caller output must be disjoint from all borrowed document storage.
vocabulary.hot_path: No allocation, retained streaming state or locale dependency. Caller owns output buffers.

independent_reference.actual_outputs: All Rust decoded strings and replacement flags rechecked against the original pinned Engram capture. Raw ID strings come from Rust id_to_token. No candidate runtime import.
independent_reference.synthetic: Every single byte and byte pair, selected three/four-byte boundary patterns, empty tokens and unmapped Unicode; expected results produced directly by the Rust ByteLevel decoder.
independent_reference.extra_future_reference: Length-counted original canonical Engram key blobs are included for the next normalization/map stage; not produced by the new native decoder.

validation.allocation_failures: Insufficient metadata budget rejects before allocation; denied constructor allocation preserves empty handle and borrowed JSON; successful retry matches full corpus. Exact JSON node caps pass; one-node-short and default config caps reject both wider documents atomically.
validation.sanitizer_scope: ASAN/UBSAN instrument all JSON/tokenizer/vocabulary/probe C code. No GPU code or kernel added; no new GPU sanitizer claim. Full existing CUDA suite and diagnostics passed separately.
validation.reference_integrity: Immutable replay byte-identical. Modified checkpoint/parent manifest rejected before output creation; conflicting reference preserved. Original corpus/new payloads and Rust library/source/binary hashes audited throughout. Four protected user binaries preserved.
validation.qwen27: Fresh strict sampled token-ID parity192/192, first8/8, count mismatch0/8.

not_claimed: Native Unicode Engram normalization or compressed token-map construction
Text encoding or multi-token streaming decoding through this vocabulary view
Request-local mapped history ownership or complete-model reset/rewind qualification
vLLM performance parity or new ARM/Metal/WASM execution coverage
